summary: Verified P0 config loading fix and new features (kelly_enabled toggle, min/max liquidity range). All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend Configuration page correctly shows Kelly toggle in Risk tab and Liquidity Range sliders in Market Selection tab. Paper trading loads correct initial_capital ($10,000) from MongoDB.
critical_code_review_comments: TradingConfig model (server.py lines 230-245) correctly includes all new fields: kelly_enabled, min_liquidity, max_liquidity, min_volume_24h, max_spread, max_open_positions
GET /api/config endpoint (server.py lines 964-999) returns all config fields from MongoDB with proper defaults
POST /api/config/update endpoint (server.py lines 1001-1087) saves all new fields to MongoDB user_config collection
Paper trader _load_user_config (paper_trader.py lines 146-208) loads ALL config from DB including kelly_enabled, min_liquidity, max_liquidity
AdaptivePositionSizer.calculate_optimal_position_size (adaptive_position_sizer.py lines 248-346) accepts kelly_enabled parameter and uses fixed sizing when disabled
Frontend Configuration.js correctly implements Kelly toggle with data-testid='kelly-toggle' and Liquidity Range with min/max sliders
seed_data_creation: Started and stopped paper trading sessions during testing to verify config loading
context_for_next_testing_agent: Config and Paper Trading fixes verified. Key findings: 1) GET /api/config returns all fields including kelly_enabled, min_liquidity, max_liquidity. 2) POST /api/config/update saves all fields to MongoDB. 3) Paper trading starts with correct initial_capital ($10,000) from DB. 4) Kelly toggle works - when disabled shows 'Kelly disabled - using fixed position sizing'. 5) Liquidity Range has both min and max sliders in Market Selection tab. 6) MongoDB user_config collection is the single source of truth for all trading parameters.
